name: What preparations should I make before Frasheski Construction arrives for a door installation?

mainEntity.name: What preparations should I make before Frasheski Construction arrives for a door installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before our team arrives for a door installation, please clear the area around the door frame, both inside and outside, to allow for unobstructed access and movement. Remove any fragile items, wall hangings, or furniture that might be in the immediate vicinity. Ensuring a clear workspace helps us conduct the installation efficiently and safely, minimizing disruption to your home or business.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before installation, clear the area around the door frame, both inside and out. Remove fragile items, wall hangings, or furniture to ensure a clear and safe workspace.
